values.maintenance: Maintains shipped state: a fix, hygiene, or polish that adds no capability.
values.extension: Extends a system past its shipped line: a capability it lacks today.

values.direct: Built by the software factory against its brief; ends in merged code.
values.spike: A question; the answer closes the issue in a comment, and no PR opens.
values.session: Led by the user in a session: worked in a worktree, PR opened by hand, never dispatched.

values.yes: The work writes or changes tests, so the build runs test-first.
values.no: The work touches no tests, so the build implements directly.

values.intake: Untriaged; intake authors the brief and routes the issue.
values.design: The approach is explored and the brief re-authored or decomposed.
values.build: Released to the factory; the build node runs next.
values.pr-review: A pull request is open and in the review loop.

values.map: A wayfinder map: the planning epic the /wayfinder skill drives.
values.research: A decision ticket resolved by research: sources outside the working directory.
values.prototype: A decision ticket resolved by a cheap, concrete artifact to react to.
values.grilling: A decision ticket resolved in conversation with the user.
values.task: A decision ticket resolved by manual work that unblocks a decision.

values.deferral: Opened by the factory to hold work a review suggested and the run deferred.
